args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

The docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
halfway amounts round to the nearest even cent, matching
tests/test_money.py (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.body:
## Summary

Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` by implementing banker's rounding per FIN-212.

## Problem

`src/money.py` documented `round_money` as using banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but the implementation actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change

- Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification

CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`): **passed**.
